+* *Refused calls*: a tool call that the authorization check of the tool refuses (the
+  xref:ROOT:ai-tool-component.adoc[ai-tool] route) is answered as a tool error with a

+  `"org.apache.camel/authorization": "denied"` in its `_meta` field, so that a client can
+  tell a refused call from a failed one without reading the text. The entry names
